summary: Sino Green Land Corp. filed an 8-K reporting completion on 2026-09-29 of two Malaysian stock purchases. It acquired 60% of Xing Da Plastics Sdn. Bhd. for 4,800,000 restricted shares and all of Invent Fortune Sdn. Bhd. for 36,527,833.33 restricted shares, each nominal $0.60 par value. Both were private issuances under Section 4(a)(2). No board recommendation, advisor, cash price, premium, or close outside the completed date is stated. The equity-funded structure deepens dilution and leaves minority interests in Xing Da; watch integration, unregistered-share overhang, and any resale registration.
